verdict.rationale: Post-call structured extraction is a fair question for a voice-agent framework, but the evidence shows no built-in feature that extracts outcomes, entities or dispositions after each call and delivers them by API or webhook. The only related material is general LLM tool use, such as calling external APIs during a conversation. That is a developer building block, not the post-call extraction-and-delivery capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call

citations.quote: Call external APIs or lookup data for RAG.
